title: 자살예방 및 생명존중문화 조성을 위한 법률 시행규칙

rows.source_ko: Ministry of Health and Welfare ( Suicide Prevention Policy Division ), 044-202-3891, 3894
rows.text_en: Ministry of Health and Welfare ( Suicide Prevention Policy Division ), 044-202-3891, 3894

rows.source_ko: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the Act on the Prevention of Suicide and the Creation of a Culture of Respect for Life and the Enforcement Decree of the same Act , as well as matters necessary for the implementation thereof.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the Act on the Prevention of Suicide and the Creation of a Culture of Respect for Life and the Enforcement Decree of the same Act , as well as matters necessary for the implementation thereof.

rows.source_ko: Article 2 (Designation of Specialized Survey and Research Institutions) ① The Minister of Health and Welfare and the Mayors of Special Cities, Metropolitan Cities, and Provinces, and the Governors of Special Self-Governing Provinces (hereinafter referred to as “City/Provincial Governors”) may, pursuant to Article 12, Paragraph 1 of the Act on the Prevention of Suicide and the Creation of a Culture of Respect for Life (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”),designate any institution or organization falling under any of the following subparagraphs as a specialized survey and research institution for the collection, analysis, and management of suicide statistics (hereinafter referred to as “specialized survey and research institution” in this Article). <Amended May 30, 2017; December 9, 2022>
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Designation of Specialized Survey and Research Institutions) ① The Minister of Health and Welfare and the Mayors of Special Cities, Metropolitan Cities, and Provinces, and the Governors of Special Self-Governing Provinces (hereinafter referred to as “City/Provincial Governors”) may, pursuant to Article 12, Paragraph 1 of the Act on the Prevention of Suicide and the Creation of a Culture of Respect for Life (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”), designate any institution or organization falling under any of the following subparagraphs as a specialized survey and research institution for the collection, analysis, and management of suicide statistics (hereinafter referred to as “specialized survey and research institution” in this Article). <Amended May 30, 2017; December 9, 2022>

rows.source_ko: 1. National and public research institutes
rows.text_en: 1. National and public research institutes

rows.source_ko: 2. National and public hospitals
rows.text_en: 2. National and public hospitals

rows.source_ko: 3. Schools pursuant to Article 2 of the Higher Education Act
rows.text_en: 3. Schools pursuant to Article 2 of the Higher Education Act

rows.source_ko: 4. Mental health research institution pursuant to Article 16 of the Act on Promotion of Mental Health and Support for Welfare Services for Persons with Mental Illness
rows.text_en: 4. Mental health research institution pursuant to Article 16 of the Act on Promotion of Mental Health and Support for Welfare Services for Persons with Mental Illness

rows.source_ko: 4-2. Korea Life Respect and Hope Foundation pursuant to Article 12-4, Paragraph 1 of the Act
rows.text_en: 4-2. Korea Life Respect and Hope Foundation pursuant to Article 12-4, Paragraph 1 of the Act

rows.source_ko: 5. Suicide Prevention Center pursuant to Article 13 of the Act
rows.text_en: 5. Suicide Prevention Center pursuant to Article 13 of the Act

rows.source_ko: 6. Other institutions or organizations with expertise in the collection, analysis, and management of statistics
rows.text_en: 6. Other institutions or organizations with expertise in the collection, analysis, and management of statistics

rows.source_ko: ② When the Minister of Health and Welfare and the mayor or provincial governor designate a specialized investigation and research institution pursuant to Paragraph 1, they shall consider the following matters:
rows.text_en: ② When the Minister of Health and Welfare and the mayor or provincial governor designate a specialized investigation and research institution pursuant to Paragraph 1, they shall consider the following matters:

rows.source_ko: 1. Whether expertise regarding the collection, analysis, and management of statistics has been secured
rows.text_en: 1. Whether expertise regarding the collection, analysis, and management of statistics has been secured

rows.source_ko: 2. Whether the necessary organization and personnel are possessed
rows.text_en: 2. Whether the necessary organization and personnel are possessed

rows.source_ko: 3. Whether security and safety suitable for the collection, analysis, and management of suicide statistics are secured
rows.text_en: 3. Whether security and safety suitable for the collection, analysis, and management of suicide statistics are secured

rows.source_ko: ③ The Minister of Health and Welfare and the mayors and provincial governors may provide financial support within the budget for the costs necessary for specialized survey and research institutions to perform their duties.
rows.text_en: ③ The Minister of Health and Welfare and the mayors and provincial governors may provide financial support within the budget for the costs necessary for specialized survey and research institutions to perform their duties.

rows.source_ko: Article 3 (Screening Tests and Counseling/Treatment, etc.) ① Pursuant to Article 14, Paragraph 2 of the Act , the Minister of Health and Welfare and the Mayor/Do Governor shall develop mental health screening tools taking into consideration the characteristics of the subjects of the test, such as age, gender, and social environment.
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Screening Tests and Counseling/Treatment, etc.) ① Pursuant to Article 14, Paragraph 2 of the Act , the Minister of Health and Welfare and the Mayor/Do Governor shall develop mental health screening tools taking into consideration the characteristics of the subjects of the test, such as age, gender, and social environment.

rows.source_ko: ② The Minister of Health and Welfare and the mayors and governors of cities and provinces shall distribute the mental health screening tools under Paragraph 1 to institutions, organizations, and facilities falling under each subparagraph of Article 17, Paragraph 1 of the Act .
rows.text_en: ② The Minister of Health and Welfare and the mayors and governors of cities and provinces shall distribute the mental health screening tools under Paragraph 1 to institutions, organizations, and facilities falling under each subparagraph of Article 17, Paragraph 1 of the Act .

rows.source_ko: ③ The head of an institution, organization, or facility that has received a mental health screening tool pursuant to Paragraph 2 may conduct a screening test on persons deemed to require a mental health screening test. In this case, prior consent must be obtained.
rows.text_en: ③ The head of an institution, organization, or facility that has received a mental health screening tool pursuant to Paragraph 2 may conduct a screening test on persons deemed to require a mental health screening test. In this case, prior consent must be obtained.

rows.source_ko: ④ If the head of an institution, organization, or facility that has conducted a mental health screening test pursuant to Paragraph 3 discovers a person at risk of suicide pursuant to Article 4, Paragraph 1 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as “person at risk of suicide”) as a result of the test, they shall guide the person at risk of suicide or their guardian to receive counseling and treatment at a public health center, a mental health welfare center pursuant to Article 15 of the Act on Promotion of Mental Health and Support for Welfare Services for Persons with Mental Illness , a suicide prevention center pursuant to Article 13 of the Act , or a medical institution, etc. <Amended May 30, 2017>
rows.text_en: ④ If the head of an institution, organization, or facility that has conducted a mental health screening test pursuant to Paragraph 3 discovers a person at risk of suicide pursuant to Article 4, Paragraph 1 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as “person at risk of suicide”) as a result of the test, they shall guide the person at risk of suicide or their guardian to receive counseling and treatment at a public health center, a mental health welfare center pursuant to Article 15 of the Act on Promotion of Mental Health and Support for Welfare Services for Persons with Mental Illness , a suicide prevention center pursuant to Article 13 of the Act , or a medical institution, etc. <Amended May 30, 2017>

rows.source_ko: ⑤ The Minister of Health and Welfare may provide education necessary for conducting mental health screening tests to the heads of institutions, organizations, and facilities conducting mental health screening tests pursuant to Paragraph 3.
rows.text_en: ⑤ The Minister of Health and Welfare may provide education necessary for conducting mental health screening tests to the heads of institutions, organizations, and facilities conducting mental health screening tests pursuant to Paragraph 3.

rows.source_ko: ⑥ In addition to the matters prescribed in paragraphs 1 through 5, matters necessary for mental health screening, counseling, and treatment shall be determined by the Minister of Health and Welfare .
rows.text_en: ⑥ In addition to the matters prescribed in paragraphs 1 through 5, matters necessary for mental health screening, counseling, and treatment shall be determined by the Minister of Health and Welfare .

rows.text_en: Article 4 Deleted <July 16, 2024>

rows.source_ko: Article 6 (Composition and Operation of the Council for the Prevention of Suicide-Inducing Information) ① The Council for the Prevention of Suicide-Inducing Information pursuant to Article 19, Paragraph 2 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Council”) shall be composed of at least 10 and no more than 20 members, including one chairperson, with consideration for gender.
rows.text_en: Article 6 (Composition and Operation of the Council for the Prevention of Suicide-Inducing Information) ① The Council for the Prevention of Suicide-Inducing Information pursuant to Article 19, Paragraph 2 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Council”) shall be composed of at least 10 and no more than 20 members, including one chairperson, with consideration for gender.

rows.source_ko: ② The chairperson of the council shall be the director in charge of suicide prevention affairs at the Ministry of Health and Welfare, and the members shall be appointed or commissioned by the Minister of Health and Welfare from among those falling under any of the following subparagraphs.
rows.text_en: ② The chairperson of the council shall be the director in charge of suicide prevention affairs at the Ministry of Health and Welfare, and the members shall be appointed or commissioned by the Minister of Health and Welfare from among those falling under any of the following subparagraphs.

rows.source_ko: 1. A person designated by the head of the relevant agency from among public officials of Grade 4 or higher (including public officials belonging to the Senior Civil Service) or equivalent officials belonging to the relevant agency pursuant to Article 19, Paragraph 2 of the Act .
rows.text_en: 1. A person designated by the head of the relevant agency from among public officials of Grade 4 or higher (including public officials belonging to the Senior Civil Service) or equivalent officials belonging to the relevant agency pursuant to Article 19, Paragraph 2 of the Act .

rows.source_ko: 2. Employees of an information and communications service provider organization pursuant to Article 3, Paragraph 3 of the Act on Promotion of Information and Communications Network Utilization and Information Protection, etc.
rows.text_en: 2. Employees of an information and communications service provider organization pursuant to Article 3, Paragraph 3 of the Act on Promotion of Information and Communications Network Utilization and Information Protection, etc.

rows.source_ko: 3. A person with extensive knowledge and experience regarding the blocking of suicide-inducing information
rows.text_en: 3. A person with extensive knowledge and experience regarding the blocking of suicide-inducing information

rows.source_ko: ③ The term of office for members who are not public officials shall be two years.
rows.text_en: ③ The term of office for members who are not public officials shall be two years.

rows.source_ko: ④ The Council shall consult and coordinate the following matters.
rows.text_en: ④ The Council shall consult and coordinate the following matters.

rows.source_ko: 1. Matters concerning the scope of suicide-inducing information
rows.text_en: 1. Matters concerning the scope of suicide-inducing information

rows.source_ko: 2. Matters concerning effective methods to block suicide-inducing information
rows.text_en: 2. Matters concerning effective methods to block suicide-inducing information

rows.source_ko: 3. Other matters submitted to the meeting by the Chairperson regarding the blocking of suicide-inducing information
rows.text_en: 3. Other matters submitted to the meeting by the Chairperson regarding the blocking of suicide-inducing information

rows.source_ko: ⑤ In addition to the matters prescribed in paragraphs 1 through 4, matters necessary for the composition and operation of the council shall be determined by the chairperson of the council following a resolution by the council.
rows.text_en: ⑤ In addition to the matters prescribed in paragraphs 1 through 4, matters necessary for the composition and operation of the council shall be determined by the chairperson of the council following a resolution by the council.

rows.source_ko: Article 7 (Reporting of Designation of Person in Charge of Data Provision) ① The report on the designation of the person in charge of data provision pursuant to Article 12, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Prevention of Suicide and the Creation of a Culture of Respect for Life shall be in accordance with the attached form.
rows.text_en: Article 7 (Reporting of Designation of Person in Charge of Data Provision) ① The report on the designation of the person in charge of data provision pursuant to Article 12, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Prevention of Suicide and the Creation of a Culture of Respect for Life shall be in accordance with the attached form.

rows.source_ko: ② Upon receiving a report pursuant to Paragraph 1, the Minister of Health and Welfare shall verify the certificate of corporate registration (only applicable to corporations) or the business registration certificate (only applicable to individuals) through the joint use of administrative information pursuant to Article 36 , Paragraph 1 of the Electronic Government Act. However, if the applicant does not consent to the verification of the business registration certificate, a copy thereof must be attached.
rows.text_en: ② Upon receiving a report pursuant to Paragraph 1, the Minister of Health and Welfare shall verify the certificate of corporate registration (only applicable to corporations) or the business registration certificate (only applicable to individuals) through the joint use of administrative information pursuant to Article 36 , Paragraph 1 of the Electronic Government Act. However, if the applicant does not consent to the verification of the business registration certificate, a copy thereof must be attached.
